1858: /// Record one CalDAV change-log entry inside the caller's transaction.
1859: ///
1860: /// This is the single, centralized point where base event mutations are
1861: /// recorded for CalDAV sync. Because the insert shares the caller's
1862: /// transaction, a committed mutation leaves exactly one row and a rolled-back
1863: /// mutation leaves none. DAV-originated mutations flow through the same
1864: /// domain-service methods, so they are recorded exactly once and never
1865: /// double-counted by the DAV layer.
1866: ///
1867: /// `resource_name` is carried for deleted changes so sync-collection (T11) can
1868: /// emit the correct href after the tombstone has cleared the live mapping's
1869: /// event reference. It is `None` for created/updated changes, where the name
1870: /// is resolved from the live mapping at read time.
1871: async fn record_caldav_change(
1872:     transaction: &mut sqlx::Transaction<'_, sqlx::Sqlite>,
1873:     calendar_id: i64,
1874:     event_id: i64,
1875:     change_type: &'static str,
1876:     now: i64,
1877:     resource_name: Option<&str>,
1878: ) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
1879:     sqlx::query(
1880:         "INSERT INTO caldav_event_changes (
1881:             calendar_id, event_id, change_type, created_at, resource_name
1882:          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
1883:     )
1884:     .bind(calendar_id)
1885:     .bind(event_id)
1886:     .bind(change_type)
1887:     .bind(now)
1888:     .bind(resource_name)
1889:     .execute(&mut **transaction)
1890:     .await?;
1891:     Ok(())
1892: }
1893: 
1894: /// Tombstone the live DAV mapping for an event, if any, inside the caller's
1895: /// transaction. Clearing the event reference before the event row is removed
1896: /// keeps the mapping's foreign key satisfied and leaves a durable tombstone
1897: /// for other clients, matching the DAV delete path (T09).
1898: async fn tombstone_caldav_mapping(
1899:     transaction: &mut sqlx::Transaction<'_, sqlx::Sqlite>,
1900:     calendar_id: i64,
1901:     event_id: i64,
1902:     now: i64,
1903: ) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
1904:     sqlx::query(
1905:         "UPDATE caldav_event_resources
1906:              SET event_id = NULL, deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ?
1907:            WHERE calendar_id = ? AND event_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL",
1908:     )
1909:     .bind(now)
1910:     .bind(now)
1911:     .bind(calendar_id)
1912:     .bind(event_id)
1913:     .execute(&mut **transaction)
1914:     .await?;
1915:     Ok(())
1916: }

1918: fn validate_mutation(event: &EventMutation) -> Result<(), EventServiceError> {
1919:     if event.title.trim().is_empty() {
1920:         return Err(EventServiceError::InvalidInput);
1921:     }
1922:     validate_timing(&event.timing).map_err(|_| EventServiceError::InvalidInput)

1925: fn validate_create_batch(batch: &EventCreateBatch) -> Result<(), EventServiceError> {
1926:     if batch.events.is_empty() {
1927:         return Err(EventServiceError::InvalidInput);
1928:     }
1929:     for item in &batch.events {
1930:         validate_mutation(&item.event)?;
1931:         if let Some(rule) = &item.recurrence_rule {
1932:             validate_recurrence(&item.event, rule)?;
1933:         } else if !item.exceptions.is_empty() {
1934:             return Err(EventServiceError::InvalidInput);
1935:         }
1936:         let mut keys = HashSet::with_capacity(item.exceptions.len());
1937:         for exception in &item.exceptions {
1938:             if !keys.insert(&exception.recurrence) {
1939:                 return Err(EventServiceError::InvalidInput);
1940:             }
1941:             let key_matches = matches!(
1942:                 (&item.event.timing, &exception.recurrence),
1943:                 (EventTiming::Timed { .. }, EventRecurrenceKey::Timed(_))
1944:                     | (EventTiming::AllDay { .. }, EventRecurrenceKey::AllDay(_))
1945:             );
1946:             if !key_matches {
1947:                 return Err(EventServiceError::InvalidInput);
1948:             }
1949:             if let EventRecurrenceKey::AllDay(date) = &exception.recurrence {
1950:                 NaiveDate::parse_from_str(date, "%Y-%m-%d")
1951:                     .map_err(|_| EventServiceError::InvalidInput)?;
1952:             }
1953:             if let Some(replacement) = &exception.replacement {
1954:                 validate_mutation(replacement)?;
1955:                 if std::mem::discriminant(&item.event.timing)
1956:                     != std::mem::discriminant(&replacement.timing)
1957:                 {
1958:                     return Err(EventServiceError::InvalidInput);
1959:                 }
1960:             }
1961:         }
1962:     }
1963:     Ok(())
1964: }

-- Transactional change log for CalDAV incremental sync.
--
-- Every committed base event mutation (create/update/delete) records exactly
-- one row here, inside the same transaction as the domain write. A rolled-back

    change_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (change_type IN ('created', 'updated', 'deleted')),

574: /// Return the `.ics` resource name listed in a calendar PROPFIND response.
575: fn extract_resource_name(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
576:     for line in body.lines() {
577:         if line.contains("<D:href>") && line.contains(".ics") {
578:             let start = line.find("<D:href>")? + "<D:href>".len();
579:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;
580:             let name = href.rsplit('/').next()?.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
581:             return Some(name.to_owned());
582:         }
583:     }
584:     None
585: }

1960: /// Issue a `PUT` to an existing resource with an `If-Match` precondition.
1961: async fn put_update_request(
1962:     app: Router,
1963:     uri: &str,
1964:     auth: Option<(&str, &str)>,
1965:     body: &str,
1966:     if_match: Option<&str>,
1967: ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, String) {
1968:     let mut builder = Request::builder()
1969:         .method(Method::PUT)
1970:         .uri(uri)
1971:         .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8");
1972:     if let Some((username, password)) = auth {
1973:         builder = builder.header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
1974:     }
1975:     if let Some(value) = if_match {
1976:         builder = builder.header(header::IF_MATCH, value);
1977:     }
1978:     let response = app
1979:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::from(body.to_owned())).unwrap())
1980:         .await
1981:         .unwrap();
1982:     let status = response.status();
1983:     let headers = response.headers().clone();
1984:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
1985:     (status, headers, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
1986: }

3537: /// Build a `sync-collection` REPORT body. An empty token requests the initial
3538: /// snapshot.
3539: fn sync_collection_xml(sync_token: &str) -> String {
3540:     format!(
3541:         r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
3542: <C:sync-collection xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
3543:   <D:sync-token>{sync_token}</D:sync-token>
3544:   <D:sync-level>1</D:sync-level>
3545:   <D:prop>
3546:     <D:getetag/>
3547:     <D:getcontenttype/>
3548:     <C:calendar-data/>
3549:   </D:prop>
3550: </C:sync-collection>"#
3551:     )
3552: }
3553: 
3554: /// Extract the `<D:sync-token>` value from a sync-collection response body.
3555: fn extract_sync_token(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
3556:     for line in body.lines() {
3557:         if line.contains("<D:sync-token>") {
3558:             let start = line.find("<D:sync-token>")? + "<D:sync-token>".len();
3559:             let rest = line[start..].trim_end();
3560:             let token = rest.strip_suffix("</D:sync-token>")?;
3561:             return Some(token.to_owned());
3562:         }
3563:     }
3564:     None
3565: }
3566: 
3567: /// Count the `<D:response>` elements in a multistatus body.
3568: fn count_responses(body: &str) -> usize {
3569:     body.matches("<D:response>").count()
3570: }

241:         return Err(QueryError::RangeTooLarge);
242:     }
243:     Ok(CalendarQuery {
244:         start_utc: start,
245:         end_utc: end,

249: /// Parse a `calendar-multiget` REPORT body into its requested hrefs.
250: ///
251: /// Only `<D:href>` elements that are direct children of the root are
252: /// captured. The list is bounded by `MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS`.
253: pub fn parse_calendar_multiget(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarMultiget, QueryError> {
254:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
255:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
256:     }
257:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
258:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
259:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
260: 
261:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
262:     let mut root_seen = false;
263:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
264:     let mut hrefs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
265:     let mut capturing_href = false;
266:     let mut current_href = String::new();
267: 
268:     loop {
269:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
270:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
271:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
272:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
273:                 if !root_seen {
274:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
275:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
276:                     }
277:                     root_seen = true;
278:                     depth = 1;
279:                     continue;
280:                 }
281:                 depth += 1;
282:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
283:                     capturing_href = true;
284:                     current_href.clear();
285:                 }
286:             }
287:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
288:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
289:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
290:                 if !root_seen {
291:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
292:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
293:                     }
294:                     root_seen = true;
295:                     continue;
296:                 }
297:                 depth += 1;
298:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
299:                     // Self-closing href carries no text; record it as empty.
300:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
301:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
302:                     }
303:                     hrefs.push(String::new());
304:                 }
305:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
306:             }
307:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
308:                 if capturing_href {
309:                     current_href.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
310:                 }
311:             }
312:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
313:                 if capturing_href {
314:                     capturing_href = false;
315:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
316:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
317:                     }
318:                     hrefs.push(current_href.trim().to_owned());
319:                 }
320:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
321:             }
322:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
323:                 if depth > 0 {
324:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
325:                 }
326:                 break;
327:             }
328:             Ok(_) => {}
329:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
330:         }
331:         buf.clear();
332:     }
333: 
334:     if !root_seen {
335:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
336:     }
337:     if hrefs.is_empty() {
338:         return Err(QueryError::MissingHref);
339:     }
340:     Ok(CalendarMultiget { hrefs })
341: }

343: /// Parse a `sync-collection` REPORT body into its sync token and level.
344: ///
345: /// The `sync-token` element is optional: an absent or empty token requests an
346: /// initial snapshot. The `sync-level` element must be present and equal to 1
347: /// for calendar sync; any other value is rejected.
348: pub fn parse_sync_collection(body: &[u8]) -> Result<SyncCollection, QueryError> {
349:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
350:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
351:     }
352:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
353:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
354:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
355: 
356:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
357:     let mut root_seen = false;
358:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
359:     let mut sync_token: Option<String> = None;
360:     let mut sync_level: Option<u32> = None;
361:     let mut capturing: Option<&'static str> = None;
362:     let mut current = String::new();
363: 
364:     loop {
365:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
366:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
367:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
368:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
369:                 if !root_seen {
370:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
371:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
372:                     }
373:                     root_seen = true;
374:                     depth = 1;
375:                     continue;
376:                 }
377:                 depth += 1;
378:                 if depth == 2 {
379:                     if local == "sync-token" {
380:                         capturing = Some("token");
381:                         current.clear();
382:                     } else if local == "sync-level" {
383:                         capturing = Some("level");
384:                         current.clear();
385:                     }
386:                 }
387:             }
388:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
389:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
390:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
391:                 if !root_seen {
392:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
393:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
394:                     }
395:                     root_seen = true;
396:                     continue;
397:                 }
398:                 depth += 1;
399:                 if depth == 2 && local == "sync-token" {
400:                     // Self-closing sync-token carries no text: initial snapshot.
401:                     sync_token = Some(String::new());
402:                 }
403:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
404:             }
405:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
406:                 if capturing.is_some() {
407:                     current.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
408:                 }
409:             }
410:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
411:                 if let Some(kind) = capturing {
412:                     capturing = None;
413:                     let value = current.trim().to_owned();
414:                     match kind {
415:                         "token" => {
416:                             sync_token = Some(value);
417:                         }
418:                         "level" => {
419:                             sync_level = value.parse::<u32>().ok();
420:                         }
421:                         _ => {}
422:                     }
423:                 }
424:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
425:             }
426:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
427:                 if depth > 0 {
428:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
429:                 }
430:                 break;
431:             }
432:             Ok(_) => {}
433:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
434:         }
435:         buf.clear();
436:     }
437: 
438:     if !root_seen {
439:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
440:     }
441:     let level = sync_level.ok_or(QueryError::BadSyncLevel)?;
442:     if level != 1 {
443:         return Err(QueryError::BadSyncLevel);
444:     }
445:     let token = sync_token.unwrap_or_default();
446:     Ok(SyncCollection {
447:         sync_token: if token.is_empty() { None } else { Some(token) },
448:         sync_level: level,
449:     })
450: }

452: /// Determine the report type from the body and parse it accordingly.
453: pub fn parse_calendar_report(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarReport, QueryError> {
454:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
455:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
456:     }
457:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
458:     let root = peek_root(text).ok_or(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot)?;
459:     match root.as_str() {
460:         "calendar-query" => Ok(CalendarReport::Query(parse_calendar_query(body)?)),
461:         "calendar-multiget" => Ok(CalendarReport::Multiget(parse_calendar_multiget(body)?)),
462:         "sync-collection" => Ok(CalendarReport::SyncCollection(parse_sync_collection(body)?)),
463:         _ => Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot),
464:     }
465: }

467: /// Read the first element name in an XML document, if any.
468: fn peek_root(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
469:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
470:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
471:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
472:     loop {
473:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
474:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
475:                 return Some(name_to_str(start.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
476:             }
477:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
478:                 return Some(name_to_str(empty.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
479:             }
480:             Ok(Event::Eof) => return None,
481:             Ok(_) => {}
482:             Err(_) => return None,
483:         }
484:         buf.clear();
485:     }
486: }

92:     pub async fn issue_credential(
93:         &self,
94:         actor_user_id: i64,
95:         label: String,
96:     ) -> Result<IssuedCredential, CaldavAuthError> {
97:         let label = label.trim().to_owned();
98:         if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
99:             return Err(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials);
100:         }
101:         self.ensure_account(actor_user_id).await?;
102:         let username = self
103:             .user_email(actor_user_id)
104:             .await
105:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
106:         let now = (self.clock)();
107:         let password = self.key.generate_token();
108:         let token_prefix = password
109:             .expose()
110:             .chars()
111:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
112:             .collect::<String>();
113:         let token_hash = self
114:             .key
115:             .hash_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &password);
116:         let mut transaction = self
117:             .pool
118:             .begin()
119:             .await
120:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
121:         let id: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
122:             "INSERT INTO caldav_credentials (
123:                 user_id, label, token_prefix, token_hash, created_at
124:              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
125:              RETURNING id",
126:         )
127:         .bind(actor_user_id)
128:         .bind(&label)
129:         .bind(&token_prefix)
130:         .bind(token_hash.as_bytes().to_vec())
131:         .bind(now)
132:         .fetch_one(&mut *transaction)
133:         .await
134:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
135:         insert_audit(
136:             &mut transaction,
137:             actor_user_id,
138:             "caldav.credential.issue",
139:             id,
140:             now,
141:         )
142:         .await?;
143:         transaction
144:             .commit()
145:             .await
146:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
147:         Ok(IssuedCredential {
148:             metadata: CredentialMetadata {
149:                 id,
150:                 label,
151:                 created_at: now,
152:                 last_used_at: None,
153:             },
154:             username,
155:             password,
156:             server_url: self.server_url(),
157:         })
158:     }

232:     pub async fn authenticate(
233:         &self,
234:         authorization: &HeaderValue,
235:     ) -> Result<DavSession, CaldavAuthError> {
236:         let (username, password) =
237:             parse_basic_authorization(authorization).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
238:         let username = username.to_ascii_lowercase();
239:         let token = SecretToken::parse(&password).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
240:         let token_prefix = password
241:             .chars()
242:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
243:             .collect::<String>();
244:         let user_id: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
245:             "SELECT id FROM users WHERE normalized_email = ? AND status = 'active'",
246:         )
247:         .bind(&username)
248:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
249:         .await
250:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
251:         let candidates: Vec<(i64, Vec<u8>)> = match user_id {
252:             Some(user_id) => sqlx::query_as(
253:                 "SELECT id, token_hash FROM caldav_credentials
254:                  WHERE user_id = ? AND token_prefix = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
255:             )
256:             .bind(user_id)
257:             .bind(&token_prefix)
258:             .fetch_all(&self.pool)
259:             .await
260:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
261:             None => Vec::new(),
262:         };
263:         let principal_id: Option<String> = match user_id {
264:             Some(user_id) => {
265:                 sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT principal_id FROM caldav_accounts WHERE user_id = ?")
266:                     .bind(user_id)
267:                     .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
268:                     .await
269:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?
270:             }
271:             None => None,
272:         };
273:         let mut verified: Option<i64> = None;
274:         let mut checked_candidate = false;
275:         for (credential_id, token_hash) in &candidates {
276:             checked_candidate = true;
277:             let expected = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes(
278:                 token_hash
279:                     .as_slice()
280:                     .try_into()
281:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
282:             );
283:             if self
284:                 .key
285:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &expected)
286:             {
287:                 verified = Some(*credential_id);
288:                 break;
289:             }
290:         }
291:         if !checked_candidate {
292:             // Verify against a dummy hash so unknown-user, unknown-prefix, and
293:             // wrong-password failures take comparable time and do not reveal
294:             // which lookup failed.
295:             let dummy = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes([0_u8; 32]);
296:             let _ = self
297:                 .key
298:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &dummy);
299:         }
300:         let credential_id = verified.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
301:         let principal_id = principal_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
302:         let user_id = user_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
303:         let now = (self.clock)();
304:         sqlx::query(
305:             "UPDATE caldav_credentials SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
306:         )
307:         .bind(now)
308:         .bind(credential_id)
309:         .execute(&self.pool)
310:         .await
311:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
312:         Ok(DavSession {
313:             user_id,
314:             credential_id,
315:             principal_id,
316:         })
317:     }

504:     /// Encode a change-log revision into an opaque, tamper-evident sync token.
505:     ///
506:     /// The token is `base64url(revision) . base64url(hmac)`. Clients treat it
507:     /// as an opaque string; the server verifies the HMAC before trusting the
508:     /// revision, so a forged or truncated token fails safely.
509:     pub fn encode_sync_token(&self, revision: i64) -> String {
510:         let (revision_bytes, tag) = self.key.sign_sync_revision(revision);
511:         format!(
512:             "{}.{}",
513:             URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(revision_bytes),
514:             URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(tag)
515:         )
516:     }
517: 
518:     /// Decode and verify a sync token, returning the revision it carries.
519:     ///
520:     /// Returns `None` for any malformed, truncated, or tampered token so the
521:     /// caller can fail safely without leaking which check failed.
522:     pub fn decode_sync_token(&self, token: &str) -> Option<i64> {
523:         let (encoded_revision, encoded_tag) = token.split_once('.')?;
524:         let revision_bytes = URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(encoded_revision).ok()?;
525:         let tag = URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(encoded_tag).ok()?;
526:         if revision_bytes.len() != 8 {
527:             return None;
528:         }
529:         if !self.key.verify_sync_revision(&revision_bytes, &tag) {
530:             return None;
531:         }
532:         let mut bytes = [0_u8; 8];
533:         bytes.copy_from_slice(&revision_bytes);
534:         Some(i64::from_be_bytes(bytes))
535:     }
536: }

538: fn parse_basic_authorization(authorization: &HeaderValue) -> Option<(String, String)> {
539:     let encoded = authorization.to_str().ok()?;
540:     let (scheme, credentials) = encoded.split_once(' ')?;
541:     if !scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
542:         return None;
543:     }
544:     let decoded = STANDARD.decode(credentials).ok()?;
545:     let string = String::from_utf8(decoded).ok()?;
546:     let (username, password) = string.split_once(':')?;
547:     if username.is_empty() || password.is_empty() {
548:         return None;
549:     }
550:     Some((username.to_owned(), password.to_owned()))
551: }

21:     event_service: EventService,
22: }
23: 
24: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
25: pub struct IcsImportSummary {
26:     pub imported_events: usize,
27:     pub imported_exceptions: usize,
28: }
29: 
30: #[derive(Debug)]
31: pub enum IcsImportError {
32:     InvalidCalendar,
33:     LimitExceeded,
34:     NotFound,
35:     Database(sqlx::Error),
36: }
37: 
38: impl IcsImportService {
39:     pub fn new(event_service: EventService) -> Self {
40:         Self { event_service }
41:     }
42: 
43:     pub async fn import(
44:         &self,
45:         actor_user_id: i64,
46:         is_superadmin: bool,
47:         calendar_id: i64,
48:         bytes: &[u8],
49:     ) -> Result<IcsImportSummary, IcsImportError> {
50:         if bytes.len() > MAX_ICS_IMPORT_BYTES {
51:             return Err(IcsImportError::LimitExceeded);
52:         }
53:         let input = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar)?;
54:         let calendar = parse_calendar(input, import_parser_limits()).map_err(map_parse_error)?;
55:         let batch = convert_calendar(calendar.events)?;
56:         let result = self
57:             .event_service
58:             .create_batch(actor_user_id, is_superadmin, calendar_id, batch)
59:             .await
60:             .map_err(map_service_error)?;
61:         Ok(IcsImportSummary {
62:             imported_events: result.event_ids.len(),
63:             imported_exceptions: result.exception_count,
64:         })
65:     }
66: }
67: 
68: fn import_parser_limits() -> IcsParserLimits {
69:     IcsParserLimits {
70:         max_events: MAX_ICS_IMPORT_EVENTS,
71:         // A calendar and its optional timezone components accompany the events.
72:         max_components: MAX_ICS_IMPORT_EVENTS + 100,
73:         ..IcsParserLimits::default()
74:     }
75: }
76: 
77: fn map_parse_error(error: crate::ics::IcsParseError) -> IcsImportError {
78:     match error.code() {
79:         IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded => IcsImportError::LimitExceeded,
80:         IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed
81:         | IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent
82:         | IcsParseErrorCode::DuplicateEvent => IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar,
83:     }
84: }
85: 
86: fn map_service_error(error: EventServiceError) -> IcsImportError {
87:     match error {
88:         EventServiceError::NotFound => IcsImportError::NotFound,
89:         EventServiceError::Database(error) => IcsImportError::Database(error),
90:         EventServiceError::ComplexityLimitExceeded
91:         | EventServiceError::Conflict { .. }
92:         | EventServiceError::InvalidInput
93:         | EventServiceError::NotSupported
94:         | EventServiceError::ReadOnly => IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar,
95:     }
96: }
97: 
98: fn convert_calendar(events: Vec<NormalizedEvent>) -> Result<EventCreateBatch, IcsImportError> {
99:     let mut masters = Vec::new();
100:     let mut detached_by_uid: HashMap<String, Vec<NormalizedEvent>> = HashMap::new();
101:     for event in events {
102:         if event.recurrence_id.is_some() {
103:             detached_by_uid
104:                 .entry(event.uid.clone())
105:                 .or_default()
106:                 .push(event);
107:         } else {
108:             masters.push(event);
109:         }
110:     }
111: 
112:     let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(masters.len());
113:     for master in masters {
114:         let detached = detached_by_uid.remove(&master.uid).unwrap_or_default();
115:         if (!master.exdates.is_empty() || !detached.is_empty()) && master.rrule.is_none() {
116:             return Err(IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar);
117:         }
118:         let mut exceptions = Vec::with_capacity(master.exdates.len() + detached.len());
119:         let mut keys = HashSet::with_capacity(exceptions.capacity());
120:         for exdate in &master.exdates {
121:             let recurrence = recurrence_key(exdate);
122:             if !keys.insert(recurrence.clone()) {
123:                 return Err(IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar);
124:             }
125:             exceptions.push(EventCreateException {
126:                 recurrence,
127:                 replacement: None,
128:             });
129:         }
130:         for override_event in detached {
131:             if override_event.rrule.is_some() || !override_event.exdates.is_empty() {
132:                 return Err(IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar);
133:             }
134:             let recurrence = recurrence_key(
135:                 override_event
136:                     .recurrence_id
137:                     .as_ref()
138:                     .ok_or(IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar)?,
139:             );
140:             if !keys.insert(recurrence.clone()) || !matches_master_kind(&master, &recurrence) {
141:                 return Err(IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar);
142:             }
143:             exceptions.push(EventCreateException {
144:                 recurrence,
145:                 replacement: Some(event_mutation(&override_event)?),
146:             });
147:         }
148:         items.push(EventCreateItem {
149:             event: event_mutation(&master)?,
150:             recurrence_rule: master.rrule,
151:             exceptions,
152:         });
153:     }
154:     if !detached_by_uid.is_empty() || items.is_empty() {
155:         return Err(IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar);
156:     }
157:     Ok(EventCreateBatch { events: items })
158: }
159: 
160: fn matches_master_kind(master: &NormalizedEvent, recurrence: &EventRecurrenceKey) -> bool {
161:     matches!(
162:         (&master.timing, recurrence),
163:         (NormalizedTiming::Timed { .. }, EventRecurrenceKey::Timed(_))
164:             | (
165:                 NormalizedTiming::AllDay { .. },
166:                 EventRecurrenceKey::AllDay(_)
167:             )
168:     )
169: }
170: 
171: fn recurrence_key(value: &NormalizedDateValue) -> EventRecurrenceKey {
172:     match value {
173:         NormalizedDateValue::Timed(value) => EventRecurrenceKey::Timed(value.timestamp()),
174:         NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(value) => EventRecurrenceKey::AllDay(value.to_string()),
175:     }
176: }
177: 
178: fn event_mutation(event: &NormalizedEvent) -> Result<EventMutation, IcsImportError> {
179:     let status = match event.status.as_deref() {
180:         None | Some("CONFIRMED") => EventStatus::Confirmed,
181:         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
182:         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
183:         Some(_) => return Err(IcsImportError::InvalidCalendar),
184:     };
185:     let timing = match &event.timing {
186:         NormalizedTiming::Timed {
187:             starts_at,
188:             ends_at,
189:             timezone,
190:         } => EventTiming::Timed {
191:             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
192:             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
193:             timezone: timezone.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
194:         },
195:         NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
196:             start_date,
197:             end_date,
198:         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
199:             start_date: start_date.to_string(),
200:             end_date: end_date.to_string(),
201:         },
202:     };
203:     Ok(EventMutation {
204:         title: event.summary.clone(),
205:         description: event.description.clone(),
206:         location: event.location.clone(),
207:         status,
208:         timing,
209:     })
210: }

use chrono::{NaiveDate, TimeZone, Utc};
use commoncal_backend::ics::{
    IcsParseErrorCode, IcsParserLimits, NormalizedTiming, parse_calendar,
};

#[test]
fn parses_timed_all_day_recurring_and_escaped_events() {
    let calendar = parse_calendar(
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Google Inc//Google Calendar 70.9054//EN
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:timed@example.test
DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Budapest:20260803T090000
DTEND;TZID=Europe/Budapest:20260803T100000
SUMMARY:Team\, sync
DESCRIPTION:Line one\nLine two\; still text
LOCATION:Room\, 1
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:2
DTSTAMP:20260801T120000Z
LAST-MODIFIED:20260802T120000Z
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=3
EXDATE;TZID=Europe/Budapest:20260810T090000
END:VEVENT
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:all-day@example.test
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20260804
DURATION:P2D
SUMMARY:All day
END:VEVENT
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:timed@example.test
RECURRENCE-ID;TZID=Europe/Budapest:20260817T090000
DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Budapest:20260817T110000
DTEND;TZID=Europe/Budapest:20260817T120000
SUMMARY:Moved
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
",
        IcsParserLimits::default(),
    )
    .expect("valid ICS must parse");

    assert_eq!(calendar.events.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(calendar.events[0].summary, "Team, sync");
    assert_eq!(
        calendar.events[0].description.as_deref(),
        Some("Line one
Line two; still text")
    );
    assert_eq!(calendar.events[0].exdates.len(), 1);
    assert!(calendar.events[0].rrule.is_some());
    assert_eq!(
        calendar.events[0].timing,
        NormalizedTiming::Timed {
            starts_at: Utc.with_ymd_and_hms(2026, 8, 3, 7, 0, 0).unwrap(),
            ends_at: Utc.with_ymd_and_hms(2026, 8, 3, 8, 0, 0).unwrap(),
            timezone: Some("Europe/Budapest".to_owned()),
        }
    );
    assert_eq!(
        calendar.events[1].timing,
        NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
            start_date: NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 8, 4).unwrap(),
            end_date: NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 8, 6).unwrap(),
        }
    );
    assert!(calendar.events[2].recurrence_id.is_some());
}

#[test]
fn unfolds_lines_and_rejects_unsafe_or_structurally_invalid_input() {
    let folded = "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:folded
DTSTART:20260803T090000Z
DTEND:20260803T100000Z
SUMMARY:Safe <scr
 ipt>alert(1)</script>
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
";
    let calendar = parse_calendar(folded, IcsParserLimits::default()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(calendar.events[0].summary, "Safe <script>alert(1)</script>");

    let error = parse_calendar(
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:broken
DTSTART:20260803T090000Z
DTEND:20260803T100000Z
END:VCALENDAR
",
        IcsParserLimits::default(),
    )
    .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(error.code(), IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed);
}

#[test]
fn rejects_invalid_timing_limits_and_duplicate_event_keys() {
    let invalid = "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:x
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20260803
DTEND:20260803T100000Z
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
";
    assert_eq!(
        parse_calendar(invalid, IcsParserLimits::default())
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent
    );

    let duplicate = "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:x
DTSTART:20260803T090000Z
DTEND:20260803T100000Z
END:VEVENT
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:x
DTSTART:20260804T090000Z
DTEND:20260804T100000Z
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
";
    assert_eq!(
        parse_calendar(duplicate, IcsParserLimits::default())
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        IcsParseErrorCode::DuplicateEvent
    );

    let oversized = "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:x
DTSTART:20260803T090000Z
DTEND:20260803T100000Z
SUMMARY:long
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
";
    let limits = IcsParserLimits {
        max_text_bytes: 3,
        ..IcsParserLimits::default()
    };
    assert_eq!(
        parse_calendar(oversized, limits).unwrap_err().code(),
        IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded
    );

    let component_limits = IcsParserLimits {
        max_component_bytes: 40,
        ..IcsParserLimits::default()
    };
    assert_eq!(
        parse_calendar(oversized, component_limits)
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded
    );

    let recurrence_limits = IcsParserLimits {
        max_recurrence_values: 1,
        ..IcsParserLimits::default()
    };
    assert_eq!(
        parse_calendar(
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:recurrence
DTSTART:20260803T090000Z
DTEND:20260803T100000Z
RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=2
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
",
            recurrence_limits,
        )
        .unwrap_err()
        .code(),
        IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded
    );
}

#[test]
fn parses_event_with_valarm_subcomponents() {
    let calendar = parse_calendar(
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Google Inc//Google Calendar 70.9054//EN
METHOD:REQUEST
BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
TZID:Europe/Budapest
X-LIC-LOCATION:Europe/Budapest
BEGIN:DAYLIGHT
TZOFFSETFROM:+0100
TZOFFSETTO:+0200

-- Migration 0027: caldav_event_properties
-- T16: Safe client-property preservation.
--
-- Stores the allowlisted, client-owned metadata for a CalDAV event resource:
-- categories, URL, transparency, alarms, and selected X-properties. The
-- incoming PUT body is the source of truth: present properties are stored,
-- absent ones are removed (the row is replaced wholesale). The row is
-- cascade-deleted with the event so no orphaned metadata survives.
--
-- properties_json is a canonical JSON document; the serialized ICS (and thus
-- the ETag) is a deterministic function of it, so identical content always
-- yields the same ETag.

CREATE TABLE caldav_event_properties (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    properties_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

+    /// Replace the allowlisted client properties for an event (T16). The
+    /// incoming value is the source of truth: an empty value clears all
+    /// preserved metadata. The row is upserted so both first-time writes and
+    /// updates (including explicit removals) are handled uniformly.
+    pub async fn save_client_properties(
+        &self,
+        event_id: i64,
+        properties: &CaldavClientProperties,
+        now: i64,
+    ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
+        let json = serde_json::to_string(properties)
+            .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
+        sqlx::query(
+            "INSERT INTO caldav_event_properties (event_id, properties_json, updated_at)
+             VALUES (?, ?, ?)
+             ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO UPDATE SET
+                properties_json = excluded.properties_json,
+                updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
+        )
+        .bind(event_id)
+        .bind(&json)
+        .bind(now)
+        .execute(&self.pool)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
+        Ok(())
+    }
+
+    /// Load the allowlisted client properties for an event, or `None` when no
+    /// metadata has been preserved.
+    pub async fn load_client_properties(
+        &self,
+        event_id: i64,
+    ) -> Result<Option<CaldavClientProperties>, CaldavAuthError> {
+        let row: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
+            "SELECT properties_json FROM caldav_event_properties WHERE event_id = ?",
+        )
+        .bind(event_id)
+        .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
+        let Some(json) = row else {
+            return Ok(None);
+        };
+        let properties: CaldavClientProperties = serde_json::from_str(&json)
+            .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
+        Ok(Some(properties))
+    }
 }

+    /// updates (including explicit removals) are handled uniformly.
+    pub async fn save_client_properties(
+        &self,
+        event_id: i64,
+        properties: &CaldavClientProperties,
+        now: i64,
+    ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
+        let json = serde_json::to_string(properties)

+        sqlx::query(

+             VALUES (?, ?, ?)
+             ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO UPDATE SET
+                properties_json = excluded.properties_json,
+                updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
+        )
+        .bind(event_id)
+        .bind(&json)
+        .bind(now)
+        .execute(&self.pool)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
+        Ok(())
+    }

+    /// metadata has been preserved.
+    pub async fn load_client_properties(

+        event_id: i64,

+        let row: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
+            "SELECT properties_json FROM caldav_event_properties WHERE event_id = ?",
+        )
+        .bind(event_id)
+        .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
+        .await
+        .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
+        let Some(json) = row else {
